summary: This bill designates the Honor and Remember Flag as an official symbol to recognize members of the Armed Forces who died in the line of duty and mandates its display at various federal locations on specific commemorative days.

scores.thoughts: This bill designates a flag to honor fallen members of the Armed Forces and mandates its display at military installations and other government buildings. While it concerns military personnel, it does not directly impact military spending or defense policy, focusing instead on symbolic recognition.
